detail: Incident opened under internal codename Mercury. Do not share the codename externally.
We reproduced HTTP 502 failures for RouteSync bulk dispatch exports containing more than 250 stops. Smaller exports are not showing the failure.
A queue saturation theory is being tested but is not a confirmed root cause. Do not characterize this as the cause.
Validated workaround: split dispatch exports into sequential batches of 250 stops or fewer. Route editing and live vehicle tracking are unaffected.
Priya Nair is the engineering incident owner. There is no approved resolution ETA. The next customer update is approved for no later than 17:00 UTC on September 9, whether or not the status changes.
A separate low-impact incident was resolved; affected accounts were notified.
